1\. The budget grace period can start late 🐞 Bug ≡ Correctness 
note_refusal() timestamps a refusal after ledger.admit() has released its lock, and
StateFile._change() permanently keeps whichever thread writes first. If the first refused request
is paused before that write, a later refused request can supply the timestamp, delaying the
harness’s grace-period deadline.
